title: Assam: Hundreds rally in Tinsukia against Siang mega dam in Arunachal

ai.summary: Hundreds of people in Tinsukia, Assam protested against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh, demanding an immediate halt to mega hydroelectric projects across Northeast India. The People’s Forum Against Big Dam organised the sit-in protest near the Tinsukia District Commissioner’s office and submitted a memorandum to Prime Minister Modi seeking suspension of all ongoing and proposed projects.

facts.claim: Hundreds of people gathered in eastern Assam’s Tinsukia on Friday (November 20), to protest against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh
facts.quote: Hundreds of people gathered in eastern Assam’s Tinsukia on Friday (November 20), to protest against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh

facts.claim: The demonstration was held near the Tinsukia District Commissioner’s office. It was the organisation’s first sit-in protest in Tinsukia against the proposed mega dam.
facts.quote: the demonstration was held near the Tinsukia District Commissioner’s office. It was the organisation’s first sit-in protest in Tinsukia against the proposed mega dam.

facts.claim: The People’s Forum Against Big Dam submitted a memorandum addressed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi through the Tinsukia District Commissioner, seeking an immediate halt to all ongoing and proposed mega hydroelectric projects across Northeast India.
facts.quote: Following the demonstration, the People’s Forum Against Big Dam submitted a memorandum addressed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi through the Tinsukia District Commissioner, seeking an immediate halt to all ongoing and proposed mega hydroelectric projects across Northeast India.

ai.background_note: The People’s Forum Against Big Dam, an organisation opposing large dams, organised a sit-in protest in Tinsukia, Assam, against the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh, demanding an immediate halt to mega hydroelectric projects across Northeast India.
